opportunities.title: Convert 2D PDFs to Tekla 3D
opportunities.description: I will send you a package of 2-D PDF drawings that detail an industrial steel structure made up of platforms, stairs and pipe supports. From these, I need a complete Tekla Structures 3-D model created. Once the model is built, use it to generate every piece of fabrication information we will hand straight to the shop floor: • Assembly drawings for each platform, stair and support as well as individual part drawings for every steel member. • CNC output: machine-ready files for cutting and drilling, plus the matching material and bolt lists. Please keep the Tekla model well-organised with sensible phase names and clear member marks so the numbering flows cleanly into the NC1 and BOM exports. All deliverables must open flawlessly in current Tekla Structures and the generated NC1 files should follow standard DSTV conventions so our machines import them without manual edits. Send back: 1. The .tekla model folder (compressed). 2. PDF sets of assembly and part drawings. 3. NC1/DSTV files grouped by profile type. 4. Excel or CSV material and bolt lists pulled directly from Tekla. Accuracy between the original PDFs and the 3-D model will be verified with an overlay check, so be sure dimensions, hole patterns and bevel details match exactly.

Once the model is built, use it to generate every piece of fabrication information we will hand straight to the shop floor: • Assembly drawings for each platform, stair and support as well as individual part drawings for every steel member. • CNC output: machine-ready files for cutting and drilling, plus the matching material and bolt lists. Please keep the Tekla model well-organised with sensible phase names and clear member marks so the numbering flows cleanly into the NC1 and BOM exports. All deliverables must open flawlessly in current Tekla Structures and the generated NC1 files should follow standard DSTV conventions so our machines import them without manual edits. Send back: 1. The .tekla model folder (compressed). 2. PDF sets of assembly and part drawings. 3. NC1/DSTV files grouped by profile type. 4. Excel or CSV material and bolt lists pulled directly from Tekla. Accuracy between the original PDFs and the 3-D model will be verified with an overlay check, so be sure dimensions, hole patterns and bevel details match exactly."

opportunities.title: Long-Term Clinic & Real Estate Web Builder
opportunities.description: # Hiring: Long-Term Website Developer / Website Builder for Clinics & Real Estate Businesses ## About the Opportunity I am building a service business that provides premium, modern websites to businesses, initially focusing on **clinics, doctors, healthcare practices, real estate agents, and property businesses**. I am looking for a reliable, skilled website developer or website-building specialist who can work with me on a long-term basis. This is not a one-time project. I plan to generate leads through my sales team and provide you with the client requirements, business details, content, images, and other necessary information. Your responsibility will be to turn these leads into professionally designed, fully functional, live websites. The ideal person should be comfortable handling recurring projects, delivering quickly without compromising quality, and providing ongoing technical support. ## 1. Scope of Work For every client, I will provide the available business information, requirements, branding assets, images, contact details, and other relevant inputs. You will be responsible for: * Designing and building a premium, professional website suited to the client's business. * Creating mobile-responsive websites that work smoothly across smartphones, tablets, and desktops. * Ensuring the design looks modern, polished, trustworthy, and conversion-focused. * Adding contact forms, WhatsApp integration, click-to-call buttons, Google Maps, appointment enquiry forms, property enquiry forms, and other relevant features as required. * Implementing basic on-page SEO, appropriate page titles, meta descriptions, image optimization, and sitemap configuration. * Setting up the domain, hosting, SSL certificate, and deployment, with the client's or my approval and access. * Testing all pages, forms, buttons, links, mobile layouts, and essential functionality before launch. * Making the website live and handing over the required access and documentation. * Providing post-launch maintenance, bug fixes, and technical support. ## 2. Types of Websites Initially, the focus will be on the following categories. **A. Clinics and healthcare businesses** * Clinic and doctor profile websites. * Specialties, treatments, services, and facilities pages. * Doctor profiles and consultation enquiry forms. * Appointment requests and WhatsApp contact integration. * Clinic location, timings, and contact information. **B. Real estate and property businesses** * Real estate agent and property consultant websites. * Property listing and property detail pages. * Property enquiry forms and WhatsApp integration. * Image galleries, location information, and lead capture. * Project showcase pages for builders and property developers. The ability to work across other local business categories in the future will be an advantage. ## 3. Delivery Timeline Speed is an important part of this business model. * A standard website should ideally be delivered within **24–36 hours** after receiving complete requirements and assets. * More complex websites with multiple pages, property catalogues, custom functionality, or integrations may require additional time, agreed upon before work begins. * You must communicate realistic timelines and flag missing information immediately. * Every website must go through quality checks before being launched. I am not looking for rushed, generic websites that look unfinished. I need a repeatable process that combines speed with premium quality. ## 4. Design and Quality Expectations The websites must look like professionally designed business websites, not basic templates with a logo and a few paragraphs added. I expect: * Premium UI/UX and clean visual hierarchy. * Consistent typography, spacing, colours, and branding. * Strong mobile-first design. * Fast loading and optimized images. * Clear calls to action that encourage enquiries and conversions. * Relevant layouts for each business instead of using the exact same design for every client. * No broken links, non-functional forms, placeholder content, or unfinished sections at launch. You may use modern website builders, reusable components, AI-assisted tools, or custom development, provided the final quality is high and the websites remain maintainable. ## 5. Preferred Tools and Technology You can recommend the best technology stack for this business model. Possible options include: * WordPress with a suitable page builder. * Framer or Webflow. * Modern AI-assisted website development tools. * Custom development when genuinely required. Please explain which tools you recommend for rapid delivery, good design quality, affordable hosting, easy maintenance, and scalability. I prefer a standardized workflow with reusable components and templates wherever appropriate, while still ensuring that each client's website feels unique. ## 6. Hosting, Domain and Deployment You will be expected to help take websites from development to production. This includes: * Connecting the client's domain. * Configuring hosting and SSL. * Deploying the final website. * Testing the live website. * Explaining recurring hosting, domain, plugin, or subscription costs before they are incurred. Domains, hosting, premium plugins, and third-party subscriptions should be discussed and approved separately. Please clarify which accounts should be owned by me or the client and which access you require. All client websites, domains, accounts, source files, and business data must remain under the appropriate client's or my control, with access handed over as agreed. ## 7. Long-Term Maintenance and Support This is a continuing engagement, not a one-off development job. After launch, I need support for: * Fixing bugs and broken functionality. * Resolving deployment and hosting issues. * Minor content, image, contact detail, and layout updates. * Troubleshooting forms, WhatsApp links, and integrations. * Website backups and basic security updates where applicable. * Communicating any issues that could affect a client's live website. Please specify what maintenance is included, your response times, and what would be charged separately. Major redesigns, new features, and significant additional pages can be quoted separately. ## 8. Expected Monthly Workload I expect to generate approximately **20–30 qualified business leads per month**, with the potential for recurring website projects as the sales operation grows. Not every lead will necessarily convert, and actual project volume will depend on client requirements and sales conversions. I am looking for someone who can begin with a few projects, establish a reliable workflow, and scale capacity as the business grows. Please share how many standard websites you can realistically deliver per week and per month while maintaining quality. Reliability, communication, and long-term commitment are important. ## 9. Commercial Proposal Please provide your pricing for: 1. A standard 4–5-page clinic website. 2. A standard 4–5-page real estate business website. 3. A more advanced property website with multiple listings and detail pages. 4. Additional pages and custom functionality. 5. Domain and hosting setup. 6. Monthly maintenance and support. 7. Urgent delivery within 24–36 hours. 8. A monthly package for recurring website projects. I am interested in a competitive per-website rate or a mutually beneficial monthly arrangement as volume increases. Please separate your development fees from hosting, domains, paid tools, and other third-party costs. I would like to start with a paid trial project before committing to a larger volume. ## 10. How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your portfolio with at least three live websites you have personally built. 2. Examples of clinic, doctor, healthcare, real estate, or other local business websites. 3. The tools and technology you use. 4. Your typical turnaround time for a 4–5-page website. 5. Your price per website and monthly maintenance fee. 6. Your realistic weekly and monthly delivery capacity. 7. How you handle hosting, deployment, backups, an

opportunities.title: 8K Audio-Video Sync Export
opportunities.description: I have two short projects that were shot in 8 K. Each project contains two MP4 camera files that need to run back-to-back and one separate WAV track captured on a separete audio recorder (RX3 pioneer decks). All I need is for the WAV to be perfectly synced to the combined video, edit the start and end so they aren’t so abrupt, then the whole piece exported as a single 8 K master ready for YouTube upload—no extra cuts, graphics. Please colour correct where possible. Because my own system freezes on 8 K timelines, you must have a workstation and software (DaVinci Resolve Studio, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar) that can render the final file smoothly. Please name the tool you plan to use and link to past jobs that prove you have handled high-resolution footage before; experience is the main thing I’ll look at when choosing the editor. Deliverable • One 8 K MP4 (H.265 or YouTube-friendly equivalent) for each project with the WAV track locked in sync from start to finish. X 2 projects I will supply the raw footage via a shared drive as soon as we agree.

opportunities.title: Editor de Videos con Ia para Producción Mensual de 20 Videos de Alt...
opportunities.description: ¡Hola! Estamos buscando una persona creativa que nos ayude a producir videos de alta calidad utilizando inteligencia artificial. La idea es construir una relación de trabajo a largo plazo, con una producción constante de 20 videos mensuales de aproximadamente 10 minutos cada uno. No nos importa si tienes 1, 5 o 10 años de experiencia. Lo que más nos importa es la calidad de tu trabajo y lo que seas capaz de crear. Queremos ver resultados, creatividad y dominio de las herramientas. ¿Qué necesitamos? Experiencia creando videos completamente con IA. Manejo de ElevenLabs y/o herramientas que permitan mantener un personaje consistente entre escenas. Capacidad para trabajar con diferentes estilos: cinematográfico, animado, documental, entre otros. Buen criterio visual, narrativa audiovisual y edición. Capacidad para mantener una calidad constante en una producción de 20 videos al mes. Importante: no buscamos videos hechos con imágenes estáticas, presentaciones de diapositivas ni recopilaciones de videos de stock o material de libre uso. Las escenas deben generarse con IA y tener movimiento, coherencia visual y una calidad que mantenga al espectador interesado. ¿Qué te entregaremos? Para cada video recibirás el guion, la voz en off, el perfil y las referencias del personaje, el estilo visual deseado y las instrucciones necesarias para producirlo. ¿Qué esperamos recibir? Un video completamente terminado, editado y listo para publicar en YouTube, con todas las escenas, animaciones, transiciones, música y efectos necesarios según el estilo solicitado. No buscamos clips sueltos ni trabajos a medio terminar. El contenido debe ser original y estar preparado para cumplir las políticas de monetización de YouTube, aunque la aprobación final depende de la plataforma. Presupuesto y propuesta Queremos comparar diferentes propuestas y encontrar la mejor relación entre calidad y precio. Cuéntanos: ¿Cuánto cobras por un video terminado de aproximadamente 10 minutos? ¿Cuál sería tu precio por los 20 videos mensuales? ¿Qué herramientas utilizas para generar los videos y mantener la consistencia del personaje? ¿Puedes compartir ejemplos de tus mejores trabajos? La calidad será nuestro principal criterio de selección, por encima de los años de experiencia o de los títulos que tengas. Buscamos a alguien que disfrute creando contenido, proponga buenas ideas y quiera crecer con nosotros en un proyecto de largo plazo. Una última cosa Si llegaste hasta aquí, escribe historia al inicio de tu propuesta y comparte tu portafolio con ejemplos de videos creados con ia. ¡Queremos ver de qué eres capaz! Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Crear o editar video ¿Qué necesitas?: Video y grabaciones nuevos

opportunities.title: Daily UiPath Report Emailer
opportunities.description: I need a UiPath workflow that logs into our web portal, triggers the daily report, waits until the report is ready, and immediately emails it to our team mailing list. The schedule is fixed: the robot should run once every day at the set time we specify in Orchestrator, so no data-change checks or weekly logic are required. The email must include the freshly generated report as an attachment (PDF or Excel—whichever the site produces) and a short, configurable body text. Please build the process in UiPath Studio, make it unattended-ready, and rely on standard activities compatible with Orchestrator, Outlook (or SMTP), and the latest UiPath.System and UiPath.Mail packages. Deliverables • Completed .xaml workflow with any reusable components • Asset/queue definitions or config file for credentials, URL, schedule time, and mailing list address • One-page setup guide so I can deploy and test it quickly in our own Orchestrator tenant If you have a similar automation in your portfolio, let me know; otherwise, a concise explanation of your approach will help me choose the right partner.

opportunities.title: Soporte de Reclamos por Chat
opportunities.description: Necesito apoyo remoto para dar la primera respuesta a los reclamos que mis clientes envían únicamente por WhatsApp o chat. Quiero que cada mensaje sea atendido con tono cordial, se registre de inmediato en nuestro sistema (podemos usar hoja de cálculo, CRM o la herramienta que propongas) y se mantenga trazabilidad del caso hasta su cierre por el área interna correspondiente. Para que funcione, valoro experiencia previa en atención al cliente escrita, redacción impecable en español y manejo ágil de WhatsApp Business, Zendesk o soluciones similares. El horario de conexión lo definimos juntos; lo importante es garantizar tiempos de respuesta cortos y un reporte diario con el estado de cada reclamo. Si ya has gestionado consultas o incidencias por chat y puedes demostrarlo, coméntame tu metodología y las métricas que sueles utilizar para medir la satisfacción del cliente. Quedo atento a tus propuestas.

opportunities.title: Polish Unreal Engine 5 RPG Demo
opportunities.description: Unreal Engine 5 Developer Needed — Open-World Fantasy RPG Review, Polish & Playable Demo Project: Existing large-scale, open-world fantasy RPG Engine: Unreal Engine 5 Current Focus: Single-player, with long-term plans to evolve into an MMORPG Contract: Freelance, potential ongoing collaboration Payment: Biweekly or milestone-based Budget: Open to proposals Project Overview I’m looking for an experienced Unreal Engine 5 developer to help finalize and polish an existing open-world fantasy RPG. The game is currently being developed with numerous gameplay systems, mechanics, environments, characters, and assets already implemented or in progress. My goal is to have someone review the existing project, verify that the systems function properly, resolve any remaining problems, improve the overall presentation, and help deliver a stable, polished, playable demo. I’m not looking to rebuild the game or pay for mechanics that are already functioning correctly. What I Need * Review and test existing gameplay systems to ensure they work together correctly. * Fix bugs, crashes, compatibility issues, and incomplete integrations where necessary. * Improve the user interface, character creation, and opening gameplay experience. * Review existing NPC and creature models, improve them where needed, or create new models that better match the game’s visual style. * Ensure NPCs, animations, dialogue, combat, quests, and other existing mechanics function as intended. * Improve environmental visuals, lighting, animations, sound, and overall consistency. * Optimize performance for an open-world game. * Deliver a functioning, testable Windows PC demo. The game is single-player first, but I want development decisions to preserve reasonable opportunities for future multiplayer expansion without requiring an MMORPG backend now. Existing Resources I can provide the Unreal project, existing 3D assets, plugins, gameplay documentation, and technical audit results. I prefer reusing and improving existing work whenever possible. Ideal Freelancer Someone experienced with Unreal Engine 5, C++, Blueprints, gameplay debugging, character animation, and RPG development. Experience with NPC AI, Blender, character creation, optimization, and large open-world projects is a plus. Payment and Expectations I prefer milestone-based payments or biweekly arrangements with clearly defined deliverables. The initial assignment would be to review the existing game and provide an assessment of what needs attention. After that, we can agree on the necessary fixes, visual improvements, and final demo requirements. I would like to see examples of your previous Unreal Engine projects, your rates, and an estimated cost for reviewing and polishing an existing RPG. Please provide an itemized proposal rather than quoting for a complete game rebuild.

opportunities.title: Modular UK House Configurator Illustrations
opportunities.description: Project Title Modular Isometric/2.5D Vector Illustrations of UK House Types, Multi-Storey Extensions, and Loft Conversions Project Overview We are a UK construction company building an interactive website configurator. Users will select a base house type and toggle various home improvements to visualize their options. Because these assets function as an interactive stack, every single illustration must share the exact same isometric perspective angle, scale, and lighting orientation. Extension and loft layers must perfectly align ("snap") onto the base houses without gaps or line-weight mismatches. Detailed Asset & Layer Requirements 1. Base House Types (4 Assets) • Detached House: Standard 2-storey modern/suburban detached layout. • Semi-Detached House: Standard 2-storey UK suburban semi. • Terraced House: Traditional Victorian style featuring a rear outrigger / closet wing profile. • Bungalow: Single-storey detached residential footprint. 2. Terraced & Semi-Detached Extensions (4 Assets) • Side Return Extension: Filling the narrow alleyway alongside the Victorian outrigger. • Infill Extension: Small courtyard/gap closure. • Rear Extension: Full-width single-storey extension across the back. • Wraparound Extension: L-shaped single-storey combining side return and rear footprint. 3. Premium Detached Extensions (4 Assets - New) • Two-Storey Side Extension: Double-height addition extending the side profile of the house. • Side and Rear Extension: Single-storey wrap extending along both the side and back. • Two-Storey Side + Single-Storey Rear Extension: A combined asset showing a double-height side addition paired with a single-storey rear extension. • Two-Storey Rear Extension: Double-height extension directly off the back of the property. 4. Bungalow Specific Modifications (3 Assets - New) • Single-Storey Rear Extension: Deep rear extension maximizing ground floor footprint. • Dormer Conversion: Transforming the bungalow roofline with a large box-dormer to show a 1.5-storey transition. • Roof Uplift / Roof Replacement Conversion: A full structural "up-lift" conversion where the pitch is raised, effectively transforming the single-storey bungalow into a full 2-storey house. 5. Loft Conversion Overlays (4 Assets) • Velux / Rooflight Conversion: Standard roofline with flush-fitting roof windows. • Dormer Loft Conversion: Flat-roofed projection out of the rear slope of the main roof. • L-Shaped Dormer Conversion: Popular for terraces; a massive loft extension extending over both the main roof slope and the rear outrigger. • Mansard Conversion: Steeply sloped, flat-topped structural roof profile typical for London properties. 6. UK Market "Bonus" Ideas (Optional/Add-ons) • Detached Garden Room / Pod: A modern, timber-clad external home office placed in the rear garden area. • Material Toggles: Separate transparent overlay layers for the extension finishes so users can toggle between Red Brick, White Render, and Modern Charcoal Timber Cladding/Zinc. Technical Deliverables • Format: Fully layered vector source files (AI or SVG) with impeccable layer naming conventions. • Style: Clean, professional architectural illustration. We require sharp lines and modern textures, avoiding cartoonish styles or thick outlines. • Alignment: All assets must be delivered pre-aligned to a master grid so they overlay perfectly when rendered by a web developer via CSS/JS. Examples: https://claphamconstructionservice.com/types-of-house-extensions/ // https://claphamconstructionservice.com/types-of-loft-conversion/ // https://plusrooms.co.uk/cost-calculator/

opportunities.title: AI Tool Mount Images & Video
opportunities.description: I need a small set of AI-generated visuals that make my 3D-printed drawer-slide mount look as if it was photographed in a real, well-lit workshop. I will supply reference photos so the shape and bright-red colour match exactly; please keep every edge, screw hole, and texture true to those photos. Visual style • Realistic workshop photos, natural lighting • Setting: a tidy, professional shop with organised tool storage • The mount must appear on a Milwaukee-style modular organiser, and where that brand look is obvious add the line “Not affiliated with Milwaukee”. Deliverables 1. Five square (1 : 1) PNG or JPG images: – Hero shot in situ with a short title overlay – Clean close-up featuring three short benefit call-outs – In-use shot, drawer pulled out while the mount is loaded – Fit-chart graphic (I will send final text) – Quality close-up that highlights surface finish and durability 2. One 10–15 s MP4 video: multiple angles plus one quick in-use clip, simple text overlays, same lighting and setting as the stills. Workflow & constraints • Original AI work only—no borrowing from other sellers. • Text on graphics must be spelt correctly. • Include the supplied copy verbatim. • One round of minor revisions is built in. • Fast turnaround: first draft within three days, final within five. If you’re confident you can match real-photo believability while respecting brand boundaries, I’m ready to send the reference images and fit-chart text right away.

opportunities.title: Planos del Sistema Electrico de un Restaurante
opportunities.description: Busco un dibujante arquitectónico o profesional con experiencia en dibujo técnico y desarrollo de planos arquitectónicos en AutoCAD, para colaborar en la elaboración de planos de instalaciones eléctricas de un proyecto académico de interiorismo. El diseño arquitectónico y la distribución interior ya están planteados. Se requiere desarrollar la documentación gráfica de las instalaciones eléctricas a partir de los planos arquitectónicos y la propuesta de iluminación existentes. Entregables solicitados Planta de instalación eléctrica de alumbrado. Planta de instalación eléctrica de contactos normales. Planta de instalación eléctrica de contactos regulados, en caso de ser necesarios. Planta de instalación eléctrica de alimentadores generales. Cuadros de cargas eléctricas. Diagrama unifilar. Detalle técnico de una luminaria del proyecto. Apoyo en la organización y presentación gráfica de los planos, incluyendo simbología, notas, nomenclatura y especificaciones. Adicionalmente, se requiere una memoria descriptiva de las instalaciones eléctricas, que podrá cotizarse por separado si no forma parte de los servicios habituales del profesional. Perfil solicitado Manejo de AutoCAD y elaboración de planos técnicos. Experiencia en dibujo arquitectónico y planos de instalaciones. Capacidad para interpretar plantas arquitectónicas y coordinar la información con el diseño interior. Conocimientos básicos o experiencia en instalaciones eléctricas de proyectos comerciales o restaurantes. Deseable experiencia con normativa eléctrica mexicana.

opportunities.title: Cinematic Instagram Reel Editor
opportunities.description: # Professional Video Editor Needed for Cinematic Instagram Reel | Human Editing Only | No AI-Generated Content **Project Type:** Fixed Price **Budget:** ₹3,000–₹6,000 **Delivery Time:** 3–4 Days **Video Duration:** Approximately 35–40 seconds **Language:** Hinglish (Hindi + English) **Experience Level:** Intermediate to Expert ## Project Overview I'm looking for a highly creative and experienced video editor who can transform my raw talking-head monologue into a premium, cinematic, high-retention Instagram Reel. This is my first personal-brand video, where I'm introducing myself, my entrepreneurial journey, and my experience building technology companies and products. I want an editor who can take simple footage and make it visually extraordinary through creative storytelling, professional motion graphics, intelligent cuts, sound design, and engaging visuals. **I don't want a basic CapCut-style edit, generic templates, random transitions, or AI-generated content.** I'm looking for the editing quality seen in high-end founder documentaries, premium Instagram creators, and professionally produced short-form content. ## Raw Footage Details - Duration: Approximately 36 seconds - Resolution: 1080p, vertical 9:16 - Format: MP4 - Content: Founder introduction and personal journey - Language: Hinglish - Footage: Single-camera talking-head monologue - Platform: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn The footage is relatively simple, so your creativity and editing skills will make the difference. ## Editing Requirements ### 1. Storytelling and Audience Retention Watch and understand the entire video before starting the edit. Identify the strongest hook, remove unnecessary pauses, improve pacing, and structure the video so viewers remain interested from beginning to end. You may rearrange existing dialogue where it improves storytelling, provided the original meaning and context are preserved. The video should feel natural, emotional, engaging, and authentic — not overproduced. ### 2. Professional Motion Graphics Use premium, custom-designed motion graphics to enhance the storytelling. Possible elements include: - Smooth animated typography and kinetic text - Creative visual illustrations of important statements - Clean UI-inspired animations - Elegant transitions and subtle motion effects - Professional masking, tracking, and compositing - Animated graphical elements that support the spoken content I want meaningful animation, not effects added simply for decoration. ### 3. Cinematic B-Roll and Visual Storytelling Use relevant, high-quality visuals to complement the monologue. Depending on what I'm discussing, visuals could include software development, game development, startup life, entrepreneurship, business operations, and technology. You may use licensed stock footage and authentic footage that I provide. B-roll must be relevant to the actual words being spoken. Please avoid generic corporate visuals, random cinematic clips, and excessive stock footage. ### 4. Professional Captions and Typography Create accurate Hinglish subtitles with visually engaging animation. Requirements: - Word-by-word or phrase-based caption animations - Modern, professional fonts - Highlighted keywords - Smooth text motion - Good contrast and readability - Proper synchronization with speech - Mobile-safe positioning Captions should enhance the visual experience without distracting viewers from the story. ### 5. Camera Reframing and Visual Enhancement Since this is a single-camera recording, creatively improve the composition using: - Smooth digital punch-ins and punch-outs - Natural reframing - Subject-focused cropping - Carefully placed jump cuts - Colour correction and cinematic colour grading - Subtle lighting and contrast adjustments Avoid excessive zooming and unnecessary camera movements. ### 6. Professional Sound Design Audio quality is extremely important. Please include: - Clean and balanced dialogue - Background noise reduction - Professional voice processing - Appropriate cinematic background music - Subtle transition sound effects - Carefully timed audio accents - Music volume automation that supports the dialogue The soundtrack should follow the emotional progression of the story, without overpowering my voice. ### 7. Natural Brand Integration The monologue includes my entrepreneurial journey and references to the companies and products I'm building, including Codexlab and Zanoo. Where relevant, these can be represented through professional typography, genuine product visuals, or subtle motion graphics. **This is not a promotional advertisement.** It should feel like a personal founder story, with businesses appearing naturally as part of my journey. Avoid unnecessary logos, product advertisements, pricing graphics, and aggressive calls to action. ## Strict Requirement: No AI-Generated Content **This project must be creatively edited by a human video editor.** The following are strictly prohibited: - AI-generated videos or B-roll - AI-generated images or backgrounds - AI avatars or artificial presenters - AI voiceovers or voice cloning - AI face replacements or synthetic facial expressions - AI-generated cinematic scenes - Automated, one-click AI video editing - Generic AI-generated motion graphics - AI-generated visuals presented as real footage I want genuine human creativity, manually designed animations, authentic footage, and professional editing techniques. AI-assisted transcription, audio cleanup, stabilization, or other technical enhancement tools are acceptable, provided they do not generate or replace creative visual or spoken content. **Please clearly confirm that you understand and agree to this requirement before applying.** ## Creative Freedom I don't want to dictate every transition, animation, or visual. I'm hiring you because I want to see what a genuinely talented video editor can create from simple footage. Feel free to propose an original creative direction. The goal is to make viewers think: *"This is a beautifully edited, interesting personal story."* Not: *"This is just another overedited Instagram advertisement."* The editing should remain authentic, tasteful, cinematic, and memorable. ## Final Deliverables 1. Final Instagram Reel in 1080 × 1920 MP4 format 2. High-quality H.264 export, with frame rate matched appropriately to the source 3. Accurate, professionally animated Hinglish subtitles 4. Properly mixed and mastered audio 5. Original editable project files (Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve) 6. Any custom motion graphics and project assets 7. Licensed, commercially usable music and stock footage, with license details 8. Two rounds of reasonable revisions included All final deliverables must be provided without watermarks. ## Who Should Apply? I'm looking for an editor who has experience creating: - High-quality Instagram Reels - Cinematic talking-head edits - Founder and entrepreneur storytelling videos - Motion-graphics-heavy short-form content - Premium personal-brand content - Documentary-style social media videos Strong storytelling and motion-design skills are more important than simply knowing editing software. ## Application Requirements To be considered, please answer the following: 1. Share your three best examples of professionally edited talking-head or founder reels. 2. How would you creatively transform a simple 36-second monologue into an engaging video? 3. Which editing software do you use? 4. Can you accurately edit Hinglish speech and captions? 5. Will you use any AI-generated content? Please confirm that you will not. 6. What is your fixed-price quote and expected turnaround time? 7. Can you provide the complete editable project files? **Applications without relevant portfolio examples may not be considered.** ## Long-Term Opportunity This is my first video as I begin building my personal brand as a tech entrepreneur and founder. If the quality meets my expectations, I'd like to work with the same editor regularly on future reels, startup stories, founder experiences, and technology-related content. I'm looking to build a long-term creative relationship with someone who understands my style and can consistently deliver excellent work. **My priority is exceptional editing quality, authentic storytelling, and original human creativity — not simply the lowest price.**

opportunities.title: 3D Pergola Configurator Development
opportunities.description: I need a web-based 3D configurator that lets my customers design an oak pergola in real time. The model must be fully rotatable, zoomable and update instantly as the user adjusts length, width, height, roof style, posts and beams. Every change should recalculate the price on the fly so that, once the design is finished, the shopper sees the final cost and can move straight to checkout. You may build the solution from scratch or integrate an existing engine such as Configurix, Three.js, Babylon.js or a similar WebGL framework, as long as performance remains smooth on desktop and mobile browsers. The tool will sit within my current ecommerce site on shoprocket and must pass the chosen variant, price and a thumbnail of the custom model into the cart. To keep the scope clear, the project is complete when the following are delivered: • Responsive 3D interface with intuitive controls (rotate, pan, zoom). • Parameter inputs for size (L × W × H) and structural options (roof style, posts, beams). • Real-time price calculation tied to our SKU and material tables. • “Add to cart” pathway that carries design metadata, image and final price. • Basic admin panel for editing prices, dimensions and available options without code. • Documentation plus a short hand-over video showing how to update the system. The visual fidelity should match oak textures and standard timber jointing; I can supply reference CAD files and images. Please outline your proposed tech stack, timeline and any similar configurators you have delivered so I can gauge fit quickly. An example of the type of configurator we are looking for can be found at www.oaktimberstructures.co.uk or www.iwood.co.uk. Please use the website and see how they design and price change as you change the perameters. We like the style of this website although they don't build pergolas. www.myoakframe.co.uk Once we have established the pergola design, we would like the software to have the ability to be used and configured on our other products which include Oak Porches, Oak Gazebos and Oak trusses. Please look these up so you understand what they are. Our website is built on a toolkitwebsite platform and our shop back end is on shoprocket

opportunities.title: B2B Electrical Website Build
opportunities.description: I’m ready to launch a professional, mobile-friendly website that will present our full range of electrical cables, accessories and related items while driving genuine B2B enquiries. The site must feel trustworthy and modern, load quickly, and make it effortless for retailers, dealers, distributors and contractors to reach us. Core build • Five pages: Home, About Us, Products, B2B Enquiries, Contact Us. • Product catalogue for roughly 20-50 items, neatly grouped into logical categories. Each product will display an image, name and concise description. • A prominent “Call Now” feature, as phone contact is our preferred first touch-point. WhatsApp buttons and a conventional enquiry form will also appear where relevant, giving visitors alternative ways to reach us. • Simple CMS controls so we can add, edit or hide products in-house without touching code. • SSL, basic on-page SEO, Google indexing and a responsive design that renders perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. • Full domain registration and hosting setup included. • Clean, scalable architecture so that shopping-cart or payment modules can be added smoothly in the future. Acceptance criteria 1. All pages and catalogue items display correctly on Chrome, Safari and Edge, both desktop and mobile. 2. “Call Now” triggers a phone dialer on mobile and shows our number clearly on desktop. 3. WhatsApp buttons open a chat with our prefilled greeting message. 4. Contact form delivers submissions to our chosen email address, validating required fields. 5. Google Search Console shows the site indexed, and a valid SSL certificate is active. 6. Admin panel allows product edits without developer intervention. If this scope aligns with your skills in WordPress, WooCommerce (catalogue-only mode) or another user-friendly platform, I look forward to your plan and timeline.

opportunities.title: Meta Ads for Trading Course Leads
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced Meta Ads Specialist to generate quality leads for Trade For Learning, a stock market education institute founded by Hariomm Dwivedi in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, India. Our goal is to attract students who are genuinely interested in learning stock market trading through online and offline classes. Key Responsibilities: - Create and manage Facebook and Instagram lead generation campaigns. - Set up Meta Lead Forms and WhatsApp enquiry campaigns. - Target potential students in Rewa, Satna, Sidhi, Katni, Maihar and Jabalpur for offline classes. - Target students across India for online courses. - Develop attractive ad creatives, banners, and persuasive ad copy. - Test different audiences, creatives, and campaigns to improve lead quality. - Optimize campaigns for affordable and genuine leads. - Provide regular reports on ad spend, leads generated, cost per lead, and lead quality. - Ensure campaigns follow Meta's advertising policies for financial services and education. Target Audience: Students, beginners, working professionals, and aspiring traders interested in learning stock market concepts, technical analysis, price action, and risk management. Requirements: - Proven experience in Meta Ads and lead generation. - Previous experience in education, coaching, or course marketing preferred. - Ability to manage campaigns and optimize lead quality. - Share previous campaign results or case studies. Please include your proposed strategy, expected advertising budget, management fee, and estimated timeline. Important: The focus is on stock market education and responsible learning. No guaranteed profits or misleading income claims.

opportunities.title: AE Global Advisory
opportunities.description: I need a modern, fully-responsive website that presents all my consultancy services for people who want to live, invest, or do business in Portugal. The site will act as the digital counterpart to my YouTube channel, so the latest videos and any playlists I choose must appear automatically on the homepage and in a dedicated “Videos & Tips” area without extra work on my side. Core requirements • Multilingual interface: Arabic, English and French, with an easy way for me to add or edit translations later. • Clean, professional design that loads fast on mobile and desktop and meets current UX standards. • One-click WhatsApp chat floating button so visitors can reach me instantly. Interactive service-request form Visitors should be able to: – Select the service they need (Visas & Residence Permits, Company Formation & Business Services, Document Help & Administrative Procedures). – Enter basic contact details, nationality, current country and preferred language. – Describe their situation in their own words and optionally upload supporting documents. Submitted data must arrive in my email and be stored securely in the site’s back-office for follow-up. Content management I want to update pages, blog posts, guides and downloadable checklists myself, so build on WordPress, Webflow, or another intuitive CMS—whatever you recommend that keeps future maintenance simple. Deliverables 1. Live, secure website on my hosting with SSL. 2. Automatic YouTube feed integration. 3. Multilingual structure (AR/EN/FR) ready with initial pages translated (I’ll supply text). 4. Custom request form with file-upload, validation and spam protection. 5. WhatsApp click-to-chat, analytics and basic SEO setup. 6. Admin guide or brief video showing me how to edit content and manage form entries. If this fits your skill set, let’s discuss the best tech stack and timeline so we can launch quickly and start helping future clients.

opportunities.title: Staircase Section Drawing (AutoCAD)
opportunities.description: I have an assignment that calls for a full-blown, academically annotated cross-section through a staircase at 1:50. You will start from a clean sheet in AutoCAD and translate everything you see in my source material into a neat, precise DWG, then export a matching PDF ready for print. What I will send you on day one: • a high-resolution photo of the assignment sheet showing every dimension already laid out • the lecture slide pack that explains the construction sequence and detailing conventions we must follow • a simple floor-plan sketch that locks the stair into position and confirms floor-to-floor levels What you will build: • an academically formatted section that carries the full set of labels, dimensions, scale graphics, and title block • clear representation of step sizes, landings, handrails, required headroom, plus the surrounding floor and ceiling layers, wall build-ups, finishes, foundation line, structural supports, and how the stair meets the roof zone if shown in the notes Acceptance: the PDF must plot at true 1:50, every dimension from the brief must check out, and the DWG should open error-free in AutoCAD 2018 or later with layers named logically. When those boxes tick green, the job is done.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "I have an assignment that calls for a full-blown, academically annotated cross-section through a staircase at 1:50. What I will send you on day one: • a high-resolution photo of the assignment sheet showing every dimension already laid out • the lecture slide pack that explains the construction sequence and detailing conventions we must follow • a simple floor-plan sketch that locks the stair into position and confirms floor-to-floor levels What you will build: • an academically formatted section that carries the full set of labels, dimensions, scale graphics, and title block • clear representation of step sizes, landings, handrails, required headroom, plus the surrounding floor and ceiling layers, wall build-ups, finishes, foundation line, structural supports, and how the stair meets the roof zone if shown in the notes Acceptance: the PDF must plot at true 1:50, every dimension from the brief must check out, and the DWG should open error-free in AutoCAD 2018 or later with layers named logically. When those boxes tick green, the job is done."

opportunities.title: Diseño CAD de Silla Salvaescaleras
opportunities.description: Se solicita un profesional con experiencia en ingeniería mecánica, estructural y diseño CAD para desarrollar el diseño de una silla salvaescaleras de concepto original, destinada a viviendas unifamiliares o multifamiliares, con una carga nominal objetivo de 160 kg. El diseño deberá priorizar la seguridad, ergonomía, funcionalidad, estética moderna y modularidad, permitiendo futuras modificaciones y adaptación a diferentes configuraciones de escaleras. Entregables: Modelo 3D del conjunto y componentes. Planos generales y detalles técnicos. Especificaciones preliminares de materiales, uniones y tolerancias. Propuesta de rieles, soportes y sistema de fijación. Lista de materiales y componentes comerciales. Esquema funcional del accionamiento y controles. Criterios preliminares de cálculo y seguridad. Identificación de riesgos y plan de pruebas. Guía básica de montaje y mantenimiento. Estimación de costes de fabricación. Formatos: PDF y archivos CAD editables, preferentemente STEP y DWG, según corresponda.

opportunities.title: Engineer Adjustable Neck Pillow Mechanism
opportunities.description: Title: Mechanical Engineer Needed for Neck Pillow Structural Improvements I’m developing a neck pillow with an adjustable chin support. I already have a 3D design but need an experienced mechanical engineer to complete the functional structure before prototyping. Scope of Work: 1. Adjustable Chin Support: Design a telescopic adjustment mechanism with a secure locking system to ensure stability and proper positioning. 2. Pillow Connection: Complete the mechanical connection between the neck pillow and the plug/connector. 3. Structural Improvements: Refine the existing design to ensure functionality, durability, and manufacturability. 4. Final Deliverables: * Editable 3D CAD files and STEP files. * Detailed engineering drawings. * Exploded assembly view, where appropriate. * Basic CMF specifications (color, material, and finish). Requirements: * Experience in mechanical engineering and consumer product development. * Experience designing adjustable and locking mechanisms. * Portfolio demonstrating functional mechanical products. I prefer to improve the existing design rather than redesign the entire product. Please include all deliverables and revisions in your quote and identify any potential additional costs upfront.

opportunities.title: Realistic AI Video: Dreadlock Removal
opportunities.description: I’m building a virtual salon that feels as real and welcoming as a cozy home studio lit by soft daylight. For this first asset I need a hyper-realistic AI-generated video focusing on a single Black female client seated comfortably while her dreadlocks are taken down, step by deliberate step. Key visual flow • Continuous close-ups of the stylist’s hands carefully undoing each lock. • Natural hand-to-hair interaction—no clipping, ghosting, or sudden “popping” artifacts. • Camera work that maintains intimacy: shallow depth of field, gentle camera pans, true-to-life textures in skin, hair, clothing, and background décor. • Environment: warm wooden floors, indoor plants, simple shelving with natural-light spill from a nearby window to reinforce the home-based vibe. Technical expectations • Final output in 4K (or highest native resolution your pipeline allows) with 24 – 30 fps playback. • Physically-based shading for both hair and skin; realistic strand behavior as the locks are loosened. • Seamless loop or clean in/out points so the clip can be edited into larger salon sequences later. Acceptance criteria 1. Every lock removal motion is complete—no skipped frames or disappearing sections of hair. 2. Hands, combs, and accessories maintain proper collision with the hair mesh throughout. 3. Lighting stays consistent to match natural daylight; no artificial color shifts. Provide the source project file (Unreal, Blender, or your preferred 3D/AI pipeline) along with the rendered video so I can reuse assets in future scenes that will include braid takedowns and full-room angles. Let me know what tools and models you’ll employ so I can ensure compatibility with the broader virtual-salon environment I’m assembling.

opportunities.title: Character Illustration for E-Commerce
opportunities.description: I need a striking digital illustration—think vivid, personality-packed character or portrait art—that will become the visual anchor for my brand, “EptaEptaEptaEpta.” The piece will be used across our store front, packaging, and promotional spots, so it must instantly communicate quality and make buyers feel they’re engaging with something special. My priorities: strong concept development, a polished final render, and files ready for both print and web. Feel free to work in Procreate, Photoshop, Clip Studio, or any tool you prefer, as long as I receive layered source files and export-ready PNGs/JPGs. Deliverables • One fully rendered character or portrait illustration in RGB (3000 px + wide) • CMYK version prepared for print (300 dpi) • Layered source file (PSD or equivalent) I’ll supply style references, brand colours, and a short creative brief once we kick off. If you have a portfolio showing expressive character work that has already helped products sell—especially illustrations with clean silhouettes and eye-catching colour—please share it when you bid.

opportunities.title: Full Business Website & Hosting
opportunities.description: I want a clean, modern website that presents my business and services clearly and professionally. The site’s primary role is informational, but it still needs to feel engaging and credible to visitors. I’ll need the standard public-facing pages—Home, About Us, Services, a Contact page that includes a Google Map with an enquiry form, plus a section where I can showcase photos, client testimonials, and a concise FAQ. All hosting and technical setup should be handled for me, including domain connection, SSL, and basic security hardening so the site is live and worry-free from day one. Because I don’t yet have any branded assets, part of this project is helping me create a cohesive visual identity: a simple logo, compelling copy for each page, and a small set of on-brand images. If you have an in-house designer or photographer, or can source quality stock photos, let me know how you plan to cover that. Please outline: • Your recommended platform or stack (WordPress, Webflow, custom HTML, etc.) and why it fits an information-driven site • Estimated timeline from kick-off to launch, including content creation • What kind of post-launch support or training you provide so I can update text or images myself I’ll consider the project complete once the site is live on its own hosting, the pages render correctly on desktop and mobile, the enquiry form delivers to my inbox, and all content and branding pieces look consistent.

opportunities.title: CNC Collision Detection AI Engine
opportunities.description: I need an AI engine that can open my CAM project files together with their 3D part, fixture and machine models, scan every programmed move, and flag any tool collision risks before a single chip is cut. The focus is solely on collisions with the machine, the fixture or the part; if the tool could crash, I want to know exactly where, when and why. The workflow I picture is straightforward: drop in the CAM file, let the AI analyse the toolpaths and geometry, then receive a clear, human-readable report plus a visual overlay that highlights the risky zones. A simple pass/fail headline is not enough—radius offsets, spindle positions and axis limits must all be considered so I can adjust the programme with confidence. Deliverables • A working collision-detection engine (library, plug-in, or stand-alone app) that accepts mainstream CAM formats and their associated 3D models. • A concise report output (JSON or CSV) and an optional 3D viewer/overlay showing collision points. • A sample dataset with at least three parts, each containing a confirmed collision, to demonstrate the engine’s accuracy and repeatability. • Brief setup notes or installer so I can reproduce your results on my workstation. Acceptance criteria • Detects every collision in the supplied test set and produces zero false positives on the provided clean paths. • Analysis completes within a practical timeframe for typical mould-making jobs (minutes, not hours). • Runs locally without requiring a live machine connection and without uploading proprietary geometry to third-party servers. If the core works well, I’m open to extending the system later to warn about air-cuts or sub-optimal feeds, but for this first phase collision detection is the entire mission.

opportunities.title: Asistente Telefónico Citas Belleza y Estética
opportunities.description: Busco un asistente remoto que atienda principalmente llamadas entrantes con el objetivo de agendar citas para mi centro de belleza y estética. Necesito una voz amable, organizada y capaz de transmitir confianza a cada cliente desde el primer “hola”. Responsabilidades clave • Responder llamadas en español con trato cercano y profesional. • Registrar nombre, servicio solicitado y datos de contacto de cada cliente. • Verificar disponibilidad y confirmar la cita en nuestro calendario online. • Enviar recordatorios breves por WhatsApp o correo cuando sea necesario. • Llevar un registro diario de llamadas atendidas y citas agendadas. Qué espero recibir de tu propuesta • Ejemplos concretos de tu trabajo anterior gestionando llamadas o agendas. • Breve descripción de las herramientas que utilizas (p. ej., Google Calendar, CRM, centralitas virtuales). • Tu disponibilidad horaria y zona horaria. Valoraré experiencia previa en recepción de spa, salones o centros estéticos, aunque no es imprescindible si demuestras habilidades telefónicas sólidas y atención al detalle. La colaboración iniciará de forma remota y puede convertirse en un acuerdo a largo plazo si encajamos bien. Espero tu propuesta.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40783953, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: Por cotizar.

opportunities.title: Bloqueo automático buzones Carbonio
opportunities.description: Trabajo con Carbonio CE 26.6.2 y debido a la eliminación de esta característica (limitación de tamaño de casillas) en la nueva versión, necesito automatizar el control de cuota de los buzones. Requiero un script ejecutado por cron (u otra alternativa que propongas) con las siguientes características: • Revisar periódicamente el tamaño de todos los buzones. • Aplicar un único límite global; al superarlo, la cuenta debe quedar impedida de enviar y recibir correos. • Mantener una whitelist configurable (por nombre de cuenta) que excluya determinadas casillas de la restricción. • Si un buzón bloqueado vuelve a quedar por debajo del límite, el sistema debe reactivar inmediatamente el envío y la recepción de mensajes. • Registrar en un log las acciones tomadas y, opcionalmente, enviar un resumen diario. • Entregar instrucciones claras de instalación, variables de configuración (límite en MB, ruta de la whitelist, frecuencia de ejecución) y comandos Carbonio/CLI empleados. Acepto propuestas o ideas nuevas que nos solucionen el problema, lo importante es que funcionen de forma fiable en la versión indicada. Al finalizar, espero el script completo, la guía de despliegue y una breve prueba de funcionamiento capturada en consola.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40783541, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Recomendaciones de productos de cocina
opportunities.description: Necesito un informe claro y objetivo que me ayude a elegir los mejores artículos de cocina y alimentación para el uso diario en mi hogar. Busco que investigues y selecciones varias opciones para cada categoría clave (por ejemplo, ollas, sartenes, utensilios, pequeños electrodomésticos y soluciones de almacenamiento de alimentos). Qué espero recibir: • Una lista curada de productos con 2-3 alternativas por categoría. • Ficha breve de cada artículo: precio promedio, ventajas, posibles desventajas y por qué lo recomiendas. • Enlaces directos a tiendas confiables donde puedan comprarse online (idealmente disponibles en mi país). • Comparativa resumida al final con tu veredicto general y consejos de compra. Valoro que tengas experiencia en investigación de mercado, reviews de productos y conocimiento actualizado sobre materiales libres de tóxicos, eficiencia energética y facilidad de limpieza. Si manejas herramientas como Google Shopping, Keepa o extensiones de seguimiento de precios, menciónalo porque suma valor. El tono del informe debe ser práctico y fácil de leer; no necesito redacción publicitaria, sino recomendaciones fundamentadas en datos y experiencia real de usuarios.
